skills.description: Identify explicit and implied commitments from meeting transcripts/emails, normalize owner/date/artifact fields, and output an accountability-ready action list with evidence citations. Use when preparing follow-ups, weekly reviews, execution tracking, or decision accountability.
triggerExamples: who owes what after this meeting
list the follow-ups from this transcript
skills.fallbackPrompt: I need a meeting transcript to extract commitments. Optionally provide: participant_directory, focus_person, meeting_datetime, extraction_mode.

skills.description: Audit the quality of decision-making from a single meeting transcript by scoring clarity, evidence, alternatives, risk analysis, and accountability; then produce concrete decision-hygiene upgrades. Use when teams need to improve decision rigor, avoid rework, and increase execution confidence.
triggerExamples: did we make a good decision
skills.fallbackPrompt: I need a meeting transcript to audit decision quality. Optionally provide: decision_focus, strategic_context, risk_tolerance, participant_directory, key_questions.

skills.description: Diagnose execution drag (aka any "friction" in a meeting) from a single meeting transcript by identifying friction hotspots (ownership, dependencies, timelines, handoffs, and scope ambiguity), scoring severity/likelihood, and producing a concrete 7-day friction-kill plan with evidence citations. Use when momentum is slipping, launches are at risk, or cross-functional delivery is stalling.
triggerExamples: find the bottlenecks in this meeting
skills.fallbackPrompt: I need a meeting transcript to diagnose execution friction. Optionally provide: team_context, focus_area, urgency_level, participant_directory, key_questions.

skills.description: Analyze an interview transcript against a role rubric to produce evidence-backed dimension scores, a hire recommendation, and interviewer coaching feedback. Use when you have a structured transcript and rubric and need a consistent, schema-valid evaluation output.
skills.fallbackPrompt: I need a few things to run an interview analysis: 1. The interview transcript (full text) 2. The role the candidate is interviewing for 3. The interview stage (recruiter_screen, hiring_manager, onsite, panel, or final) 4. A rubric with at least one scoring dimension (name, description, scale 1-4)

skills.description: Analyze a meeting transcript to surface risks, unresolved tensions, hidden assumptions, decision gaps, and recommended actions with evidence-backed citations. Use when you have a meeting transcript and need a structured risk assessment.
triggerExamples: what are the risks from this meeting
what tensions came up in this meeting
skills.fallbackPrompt: I need a meeting transcript to surface risks and tensions. Optionally provide: meeting_title, meeting_datetime, participant_directory, key_questions.

skills.description: Adversarial analysis of a meeting transcript to surface failure modes, hidden assumptions, and decision risks. Use when stress-testing a strategy, proposal, or plan discussed in a meeting. Supports two modes: transcript-only (broad scan) or transcript + focus (targeted stress-test of a specific idea). Optional inputs: context, audience, risk_tolerance, focus_idea, focus_questions, constraints.
triggerExamples: what could go wrong with this strategy
skills.fallbackPrompt: I need a meeting transcript to red-team. Optionally provide: context, audience, risk_tolerance, focus_idea, focus_questions, constraints.

skills.description: Analyze meeting transcripts and decision context to map stakeholders, infer stances/incentives, identify coalition dynamics and execution risks, and produce an actionable engagement plan. Use when preparing decisions, alignment plans, launches, roadmap changes, or cross-functional initiatives where stakeholder buy-in is critical.
triggerExamples: map the stakeholders for this decision
skills.fallbackPrompt: I need a meeting transcript to map stakeholders. Optionally provide: focal_decision, analysis_goal, org_context, stakeholder_directory, time_horizon.

triggerExamples: how can I be more effective in meetings
skills.fallbackPrompt: I need a meeting transcript to coach your communication. Optionally provide: user_name, communication_goal, audience_context, tone_target, focus_areas.

triggerExamples: what was decided in this meeting
skills.fallbackPrompt: I need the meeting transcript to extract decisions and action items.
I need at least a description of the action item to track.
